summary.text: Kimberly Simmons Robinson is the Republican nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 23 (3 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Prince George's County resident whose career has spanned federal government service, private industry and entrepreneurship.

paragraphs.text: Kimberly Simmons Robinson says in a Ballotpedia survey that she has more than 40 years of experience working with local leaders and nonprofit organizations in Maryland.
She advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary, finishing second of two candidates with 49.3% of the vote.
Her stated campaign messages are making Maryland more affordable by lowering taxes and fees, creating opportunities for citizens, schools and businesses, and promoting safer communities.
